row.notes: thunk=Ne_Log_Body. Channel logger (channel, printf fmt, ...): the body formats with the static CRT vsprintf (options|2) into a buffer of at most 0x800, turns CR/LF into spaces, '"' into ''' and '\\' into '/', then hands (channel, text) to the sink at [0x14604bbc8]. 14672 rel32 call sites; each one sits behind a g_Ne_LogGate check (enabled byte == 1 and the site's channel hash in the set), so the retail game never reaches it. Channels seen: F1OS, NETWORK, TOP_LEVEL_UI, WARN, TRACE, UI, FLOW, ACTOR_ERROR, ...

verify.notes: V0014 0x1406d4c80 is e9 rel32 to 0x14847a000 (.data1). Body: rcx channel kept in rsi; rdx fmt goes to r9 of CRT vsprintf 0x14532e54c (opts|2, sizing pass then a buffer capped at 0x800 from the [[sink+0x209d8]+0x10] allocator); r8/r9 spilled to home slots as va_list; CR/LF to space, dquote to squote, backslash to slash; then 0x1406d4e10(sink=[0x14604bbc8], channel, &{alloc,text}) which stores channel and text into a record; buffer freed via alloc vtbl+0x38. Proto void(const char*, const char*, ...) matches. 14672 E8 rel32 call sites in .xtls (plus 1058 E8 and 66 E9 in .data1). Not every site is gated: see g_Ne_LogGate verify (0x14119c4cc).
